question: Should Browser CLI intentionally impose a 1 MiB maximum on existing `--fields-file` input, and if so what compatibility and documentation contract should users receive?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes acceptance of existing user files; the repository policy treats new limits and removed fallbacks as compatibility-sensitive decisions.

options.title: Approve a documented 1 MiB contract
options.body: Keep the cap, document the Browser CLI limit and error behavior, and add exact-boundary coverage before merge.

options.title: Preserve existing acceptance
options.body: Do not impose a fixed rejection threshold until a different resource-control design can protect reads without invalidating existing valid files.

recommendation.title: Approve a documented 1 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Keep the cap, document the Browser CLI limit and error behavior, and add exact-boundary coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.person: Browser CLI history owner not identified
likelyOwner.reason: A current Browser CLI feature owner is needed to decide whether rejecting existing large descriptor files is intended product behavior.
